title: Genesis
brief: The logo and the first plot. Painted before anyone else showed up.
author: genesis

title: Light and dark switch
brief: The page follows the system theme. Add a switch that overrides it and remembers the choice.

title: A pixel mascot
brief: Draw the $OS mascot right here. Palette colours only, one pixel per tile.

title: Mini-game for the site
brief: A small browser game that runs on this page. Any idea, as long as it is fun in 30 seconds.

title: Live merge feed
brief: Show the latest approved contributions as a live feed on the page.

title: X banner, 1500 by 500
brief: A banner for the $OS X account built from the canvas. Paint its miniature here.

title: Canvas timelapse
brief: A replay button that repaints the canvas plot by plot, in the order they were approved.

title: Sticker pack
brief: Six reaction stickers for replies on X, drawn in the canvas palette.

title: Spanish version
brief: Translate the page into Spanish with a language switch that remembers the choice.

title: A sound for each pixel
brief: A short, quiet sound when a pixel is painted, with a mute switch that is easy to find.

title: Contributor leaderboard
brief: A ranking of contributors by plots painted and lore written, read from the live data.
